summary: OBOOK Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ: OWLS) filed a Form 6-K on August 14, 2026, announcing preliminary unaudited first-half 2026 revenue of approximately $3.85–$3.90 million and providing an operating update for OwlPay Harbor, its cross-border digital currency payment platform. Key metrics include ~$96 million annualized payment volume (July) and ~$130 million trailing-30-day volume, with sequential monthly growth. The company expects full results on August 21, 2026. This is a routine earnings pre-announcement and business update, not a special situation.
